top_signals.title: China Is Finding Workarounds on Restrictions: Sara Hsu
top_signals.summary: Sara Hsum University of Tennessee at Knoxville's Supply Chain Management Clinical Associate Professor says China has already been developing domestic supply chains and advanced semiconductors as a policy priority. She speaks with Romaine Bostick and Ed Ludlow on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Willy Shih on Risks With Nvidia’s Supply Chain
top_signals.summary: Willy Shih, Harvard Business School professor of management practice, discusses how NVIDIA’s supplier network and rising purchase commitments help it reserve production capacity amid intense competition. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Ed Ludlow on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Former Darden CEO: Cava Better Off As A Private Company
top_signals.summary: Clarence Otis, Darden Restaurant's former Chairman and CEO discusses how restaurants are responding to rising food, labor and real estate costs as menu prices increase and consumers face more pressure on their budgets. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Lighter incident exposes risks beyond withdrawal controls
top_signals.summary: Crypto platforms need enforceable limits on every route an API key can use to transfer value, including trades, internal transfers and shared pools.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Tech paranoia intensifies after outages roil public trust
top_signals.summary: Breakdowns over the past week have caused enough havoc to spur American consumers into a panic-buying spree.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
